_about: Example name map for fix_srt.py. Copy it next to your project, delete what you do not need, add what your transcript gets wrong. Entries run top to bottom; long phrases before their sub-words. 'from'/'to' = literal whole-word phrases; 'pattern'/'replace' = Python regex per caption line (^ = start of the caption line). 'review' = ambiguous words a human must check; they are reported, never replaced.

fixes.note: the creator's own name: put the real spelling and the lookalikes your transcripts produce; scoped to the self-introduction because the lookalike can be a real name elsewhere
only at the start of a caption line, where context makes it unambiguous
drop 'Hydra' if your video also talks about the real Hydra
only if your video never says 'codecs' for real
grammar slips are fair game too, but only unambiguous ones
